title: Cascading Style Sheet injection in Image plugin in Apache JSPWIKI versions 2.1.4 through 3.0.0 on all platforms allows…
description: Apache JSPWIKI versions 2.1.4 through 3.0.0 contain a Cascading Style Sheet (CSS) injection vulnerability in the Image plugin. This flaw allows an authenticated attacker to edit a page and potentially trick users into clickjacking or phishing attacks. The issue is resolved in version 3.0.1, which users are advised to upgrade to.
